li.label: a tickling throat
li.description: The back of my throat is dry and tickling, all day long. It's the spores.

li.label: spore cough
li.description: I cough every few breaths, and it tastes of mushrooms.

li.label: a dull headache
li.description: There's a dull ache behind my eyes. It's the fumes off the ground.

li.label: a fume headache
li.description: The headache hammers away all day, and the air tastes of the seeps.
